thread:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy failed for release v1.9.4 -> auto-rollback executed to v1.9.2. Reason: migration task timed out and integration shard B returned 502s.

sasha: saw the rollback. full logs: `MigrationRunner.apply(20260321_add_user_flags) timed out after 90s`. a couple of stack traces after that.

raj: are the integration 502s correlating with the migration timeout or a separate flake?

kim: looks tied. the migration opens a long table lock on users; shard B hits queries that time out and CI marks it failed.

carol: quick ask — is this blocking the promote to prod window at 14:00 UTC?

sasha: yes we should hold. current plan options: pin canary to v1.9.2 and re-run canary without the migration, or fix migration (add batching/guard) and rerun.

raj: pin+re-run seems faster. we can cherry-pick everything except the migration commit. then run smoke and the three integration shards.

kim: agree for unblock. but we need to add a migration guard so prod rollout won't reintroduce the long lock. can we add `--allow-long-locks` flag gated behind a feature toggle?

sasha: creating a quick PR to revert the migration commit in canary: https://pr.internal/4821 (WIP). will request review from infra.

deploy-bot: CI job 982344 started for pr-4821 · status: running. (link to job)

carol: thumbs — whoever is on-call for DB migrations, can you validate the guard approach? pinging @kim.

kim: I can review. also propose running the migration in dry-run against a 10k-sample of staging dataset first. less risk.

raj: if we pin, we should document in release notes: "skipped user_flags migration in canary; manual rollout pending". I'll draft.

sasha: ok pinned canary to `redwood:1.9.2-candidate` and started manual smoke. logs look green so far.

deploy-bot: Manual smoke run complete · shards A,B,C: green/green/green · e2e: flaky but passing (2/3).

carol: good. decision: hold promotion to prod till 14:00 UTC change window, merge the migration-guard PR, run migration dry-run at 12:30 UTC, and then promote if green. agreed?

raj: agreed. I'll also add a line to release notes and set the rollback rationale.

kim: I'll finish the guard PR and run the dry-run. if the dry-run still times out, we revert migration for the release and schedule a follow-up patch.

sasha: leaving a TODO in the release checklist: `MIGRATION: dry-run ok` before prod promote.

carol: filing a brief incident note in release channel for transparency. cc: security & support.

raj: one more — let's tag the canary job id (982344) in the release notes so we can correlate logs if users report issues.

sasha: done. tagging `ci/982344` in the notes.

deploy-bot: PR 4821 CI passed · ready-to-merge.

kim: merging on my side in 5m, kicking off dry-run at 12:30 UTC. will post results here. :thumbsup:

carol: thanks team — we'll hold the promote and reconvene at 13:45 UTC for final go/no-go.
